sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Escort is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Greetings, warrior. Get over here, I've got a job for you. As you know, I deal in gear and supplies, and I've got my boys searching every corner of Tarkov for useful loot. Problem is, order are piling up, and sending them out without protection is asking for trouble. That's where you come in. Keep my boys safe along their route. Make those former PMC mercs think twice before taking a shot at them. I'll show you the route on the map. Got it? Good. Here's the catch: you've got to do it all in only a couple runs maximum. My boys won't sit around waiting if something happens to you. Don't let me down, soldier."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on daytime Factory
- Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on Customs
- Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on Shoreline
- Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on Reserve
- Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on Woods
- Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on Interchange
- Eliminate 2 PMC operatives in The Lab
- Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on Ground Zero

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +1.5
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- +4 Grenade Launchers skill levels
- +4 Underbarrel Launchers skill levels
- +4 Mag Drills skill levels
- 1× SR-2M Veresk 9x21 submachine gun FSB
- 1× Rys-T assault helmet (Black)
- 1× Rys-T face shield
- Unlocks purchase of SR-2M Veresk 9x21 submachine gun at Prapor LL4
- Unlocks craft for Rys-T assault helmet (Black) at Lavatory level 3
"Ah, here is our hero! Well done, my dogs have already reported that everything went well. Thank you, really helped me out."

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "So you failed, warrior? I've been told that my guys had to get back on their own, they lost a lot of people and couldn't even find much loot either. Alright, I'll forgive you this time. The next group is packing up soon, so if you want to make amends, then go with them."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: You must kill 2 PMC's on each listed location consecutively without dying, disconnecting, or running out the timer 2 times. If you do any of these more than 1 time you will have to start again. You do not have to do the maps in any order, they can be done in any fashion as long as you survive.
